dataSet.name: НаборДанных1
dataSet.query: SELECT TimeMeasurements.KeyOperation AS KeyOperation, TimeMeasurements.Duration / CASE WHEN TimeMeasurements.Weight = 0 THEN 1 ELSE TimeMeasurements.Weight END AS Duration, CASE WHEN TimeMeasurements.Duration / CASE WHEN TimeMeasurements.Weight = 0 THEN 1 ELSE TimeMeasurements.Weight END <= TimeMeasurements.KeyOperation.TargetTime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Т, CASE WHEN TimeMeasurements.Duration / CASE WHEN TimeMeasurements.Weight = 0 THEN 1 ELSE TimeMeasurements.Weight END > TimeMeasurements.KeyOperation.TargetTime AND TimeMeasurements.Duration / CASE WHEN TimeMeasurements.Weight = 0 THEN 1 ELSE TimeMeasurements.Weight END <= 4 * TimeMeasurements.KeyOperation.TargetTime THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END AS Т4_Пополам, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TimeMeasurements.Date, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS NumberMeasurements, TimeMeasurements.DateFrom AS Period, TimeMeasurements.User AS User, TimeMeasurements.Hotel AS Hotel FROM InformationRegister.APDEXTimeMeasurements AS TimeMeasurements {WHERE (TimeMeasurements.DateFrom BETWEEN &ПериодНачало AND &ПериодОкончание), (TimeMeasurements.SessionNumber IN (&НомерСеанса))}

totalField.expression: ВЫБОР КОГДА СУММА(NumberMeasurements) > 0 ТОГДА (СУММА(Т) + СУММА(Т4_Пополам)) / СУММА(NumberMeasurements) ИНАЧЕ 0 КОНЕЦ

ВЫБОР КОГДА СУММА(NumberMeasurements) < 2 ТОГДА 0 ИНАЧЕ (СУММА(Duration * Duration) - 2 * СРЕДНЕЕ(Duration) * СУММА(Duration) + СУММА(NumberMeasurements) * СРЕДНЕЕ(Duration) * СРЕДНЕЕ(Duration)) / (СУММА(NumberMeasurements) - 1) КОНЕЦ

SQRT(ВЫБОР КОГДА СУММА(NumberMeasurements) < 2 ТОГДА 0 ИНАЧЕ (СУММА(Duration * Duration) - 2 * СРЕДНЕЕ(Duration) * СУММА(Duration) + СУММА(NumberMeasurements) * СРЕДНЕЕ(Duration) * СРЕДНЕЕ(Duration)) / (СУММА(NumberMeasurements) - 1) КОНЕЦ)
